name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task says the switch must be flipped before the exit is reached, with reaching the exit only as the condition. Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard captures this, and it matches the worked case of 'if a happens, b must have happened first'. No Existence is needed because the task does not require reaching the exit, and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, the switch must have been flipped at an earlier step; the exit may not come before the first switch flip. Reaching the exit is not itself required.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
